subject.title: feat: add model auth profile removal command

question: Should OpenClaw expose permanent auth-profile deletion as `openclaw models auth remove` rather than keep removal limited to lower-level repair/store workflows?
rationale: The implementation is a new destructive public CLI contract affecting provider credentials and agent-store ownership; tests can validate mechanics but cannot choose the long-term product surface.

options.title: Accept the CLI contract
options.body: Rebase the branch, preserve its explicit confirmation and inherited-store safeguards, then complete normal merge review.

options.title: Narrow the product surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller operator or Doctor-based recovery path if maintainers do not want deletion as a general model-auth subcommand.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Keep the linked feature request open while maintainers decide whether credential removal belongs in this command group.

recommendation.title: Accept the CLI contract
recommendation.body: Rebase the branch, preserve its explicit confirmation and inherited-store safeguards, then complete normal merge review.
